sections.name: File setup, stateAt, base
sections.title: Test setup and real chase
sections.what: Imports the file, temp folder and hashing tools, the test tools, the match parser, the outcome and option functions, the rights check, and the fit script. Loads the models and one 2017 chase, and defines helpers for game state.
sections.why: Gives the tests real data and helper functions.
sections.watch_out: The fixed fixture id and year tie these tests to one specific match.

sections.name: option-conditioned win probability on real data (options)
sections.title: Real-chase option checks
sections.what: Checks the artifact hash and that a rebuild matches. Checks that the intent decision offers three options with distinct probabilities, and that tempo offers at least two. Checks that shrinkage lands between raw counts and the prior. Checks that death bowling is marked insufficient and not offered before the death overs. Checks the coin-flip band across states and the bowling-style source rights and loader.
sections.why: Likely reason: prevents guesses being shown as facts, and keeps the data sources permitted.
sections.watch_out: Several tests depend on the exact label names. Renaming a label breaks them.

summary: Checks the option-based win probability on real chase data: the artifact hash and rebuild, the options for intent and tempo decisions, shrinkage, the insufficient-data rule for death bowling, the coin-flip band, and the rules for where bowling styles come from.
purpose: Makes sure decisions shown on real moments are either trustworthy or honestly marked as insufficient.
why: Likely reason: the feature must not present thin data as a clear answer.
how: Loads the outcome and option artifacts and one 2017 chase. Rebuilds the option artifact and compares it with the saved one. Checks the intent and tempo options, the shrinkage formula, the death-bowling insufficiency, the coin-flip band across states, and the style loader, which drops names that appear more than once and checks the source may be used for training.
inputs: data/models/outcomes-v1.json, data/models/options-v1.json, the fixture for match 1082625, and a small styles file written to the system temp folder during the test.
outputs: Pass or fail. The test creates a temporary file in the system temp folder.
risks: The rebuild check fails for any change in fitting data or code. The rights check depends on a permission rule for the source.
debug: If the rebuild fails, rerun the fit-options script and compare the output. If the styles check fails, look at how the loader handles duplicate names.
